items.note: System paper whose evaluation compares Polymind, a multi-agent LLM diagramming tool, with ChatGPT for prewriting idea generation; the abstract reports customizability and speed of expanding ideas, and it is unclear whether idea quality or creativity is scored (arXiv 2502.09577 is the same work).

Five preregistered randomized field experiments on generative-AI use in team NPD ideation, with idea diversity, novelty, fluency, and usefulness as outcomes; the abstract gives 528 individuals in 176 teams in total across the five experiments, not the largest single one, and randomization may be at the team level; conference abstract only.

20 designers used GAN-generated combinational stimuli versus ordinary combinational images in two design tasks and self-evaluated the stimuli; outcomes appear self-reported, and the GAN-fused stimuli are not prompt-based generative AI.

Two simulation-based experiments and one field experiment vary AI-first versus human-first idea-generation sequence and measure idea diversity and creativity (an ai_design contrast); conference abstract, sample sizes not given.

Comparative experiment of a human-AI co-creative design process versus the traditional design process among novice and experienced designers, with creative performance as the outcome; assignment and sample size not given.

20 practitioners made AI-generated anime clips under a baseline or a structured Kano-AHP workflow (both use generative AI, so an ai_design contrast); 5 experts and 60 viewers rated quality dimensions, and only the viewer rating allocation is stated as randomized.

Randomized field experiment delivering LLM feedback on 31,000+ arXiv preprints to 45,000+ researchers; outcomes are manuscript revision and later LLM use, with no creativity or diversity measure in the abstract.

CHI system paper: 16 professional concept designers compared AIdeation with their current tools and workflows, reporting higher creativity, efficiency, and satisfaction; creativity may be self-rated, and the sample is below 50 (arXiv 2502.14747 is the same work).

Crossover experiment (8 designers, 16 users) comparing the multimodal Multi-PDAI participatory-design platform with Stable Diffusion; 10 experts rated generated robot-design images as more innovative and aesthetic (an AI-versus-AI configuration contrast, sample below 50).

Crowdsourced mixed-methods experiment on workplace smart replies showing that machine suggestions change the content people author; borderline, since the outcome is content and agency rather than a creativity or diversity score, and whether the smart replies are language-model based needs checking (arXiv 2210.06470 is the same work).
